[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that these concepts allow for effective combination of semantics, updating semantics with new axioms, and providing analytic axiomatizations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant described analytic calculi as valuable tools in logic for decision procedures and proof-search capabilities.
